༄༅/ /zab lam nā ro chos drug gi/'khrul 'khor zin bris mthong tsam gyis/ /khong chud don dang ldan pa yi/ /gsung rgyun go bde rab gsal bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zab lam nā ro chos drug gi /'khrul 'khor zin bris mthong tsam gyis// khong chud don dang ldan pa yi// gsung rgyun go bde rab gsal bzhugs//

swasti pra dza bhyaḥ mchog tu mi 'gyur chos dbyings ye shes khams// bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'dus ma byas// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rnam par rol pa ni// cir yang ston pa don brgyud bla mar 'dud// rnam dag nges don bka' gsang zab mo'i chos// bla na med pa'i rgyud sde'i yang snying gang*// rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// ye shes mngon sum rgyud smin grol ba yi// rim gnyis dngos grub myur lam mthar thug mchog /paṇa chen nā ro'i chos drug ces grags pa// grub thob skar tshogs lta bu gshegs pa'i shul// skal ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs// gzhung don khrid rim sngon byon gong ma yi// bka' las gsal zhing 'dir ni lus sbyong gi /'khrul 'khor phyag len khungs btsun go bde ba// rdo rje'i dam tshig ldan pa'i slob ma la// phan phyir bkod la chos bdag ḍā ki yis// bka' yi gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlobs// de yang bsam gtan tsher mas dben pa'i gnas// bde ba'i gdan 'khod dang po thun mong gi /sngon 'gror blo sbyong de nas thun min gyi// sngon 'gro bsags sbyong chos rnams nan tan 'bad// de nas dngos gzhi gtum mo lam gyi gzhung*// sgyu lus lam gyi bogs 'don rmi lam ni// lam gyi tshod 'dzin 'od gsal lam sgron me// de ltar rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag ni// bar do lam gyi sun ma 'pho ba ni// lam gyi skyel mar gsungs phyir de kun gyi// snying po gtum mo'i nyams len gzhir byas te// rtsa rlung thig le gnad du bsnun pa yis// zag med ting 'dzin ye shes bskyed phyir du// rdo rje'i lus la 'khrul 'khor 'di ltar bskor/ ༈ /sngon 'gro rlung skyon sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// rlung bzung mi dgos lus gnad chos bdun bca'// lag mthil gnyis kyis rkang mthil shad kyis byugs// lan gsum dang bcas lag gnyis 'khyud pa'i rgya// bkrol dang rdor skyil bshigs pa dus mnyam bcas// lag gnyis brla g.yas dpyi mgor thal brdeb bcas// phyir byug rkang pa brkyang nas long bu bsdam// nang nas yar byug rkang pa bskum pa bcas// de bzhin g.yas gsum dang ni g.yon gsum bya// rdor skyil dpung brgyang lag gnyis thal rdeb dang*// 'phur ba dang bcas lan gsum lag g.yas kyis// g.yon ngos phrag dpung phyir byugs lag mgo nas// nang la mchan khung bar du yar byugs 'phral// lag g.yas shad brkyang de ltar g.yon gsum dang*// g.yas gsum bya zhing lag gnyis rdor skyil thad// phyir bstan yar khyer mchan brdeb brgyab nas su// mdun du brkyang zhing lag g.yas dpral ba dang*// g.yon gyis ltag pa nas bskor sngar bzhin du// mchan rdeb dang bcas lan gsum mgo 'phur zer// lag mthil gdong la phyir byug lkog ma'i thad// thal rtse sprad pa phyir bstan de 'dra gsum// lag mthil g.yas steng g.yas 'og res mos kyis// nu 'phur g.yas gsum g.yon gsum khu tshur gnyis// mdun rgyab res mos phyir byug gsum byed pa// de yis drug tshang khu tshur mdzub bskor gyis// g.yas g.yon mkhal 'phur gsum bya de nas rlung*/

༈ /'bud pa dgu phrug khu tshur gnyis sbubs shing*// brla bzhag lag g.yon pus steng nas yar khyer// mchan rdeb mdun brkyang khu tshur mdzub bskor bcas// gru mo thad brgyang mdzub mos sna g.yon bkag /g.yas nas rngub cing 'bud pa gsum re bya// mchan rdeb mdun brkyang brla bzhag de bzhin du// g.yas kyis tshar mtshams khu tshur gnyis brlar sbubs// sna bug gnyis nas rngub dgang 'bud gsum bya// khu tshur gyen bstan bum can ci nus bzung*/ ༈ /de nas rtsa khrus yan lag lnga sbyong ni// lus gnad dang bcas rlung bzung khu tshur gnyis// pus steng yar khyer mchan rdeb mdun brkyang 'phral// brang rdeg mchan rdeb gong bzhin gsum bya zhing*// lag g.yas g.yon gyis phrag dpung phyir byug nas// mkhrig ma'i mtshams nas nang la mchan khung bar// yar byug lag g.yas shad brkyang de ltar du// g.yon gsum g.yas gsum bya zhing thal brdeb 'phur// lan gsum dang ni pus steng thal mo gnyis// phyir bstan yar khyer mchan brdeb mdun du brkyang*// lag g.yon dpral ba g.yon pas ltag pa bskor// gong bzhin mchan brdeb dang bcas lan gsum bya// mdun rgyab res mos phyir byug gsum gyi rjes// skyil krung bshig cing lag gnyis brla g.yas kyi// dpyi mgor thal brdeb dang bcas phyir byug nas// rkang brkyang mthil nas nang la yar byug dus// rkang pa bskum zhing de ltar lan gsum rjes// lag g.yon rkang g.yas rgyab dang mthil la bzung*// khu tshur g.yas kyis pus mo mnan nas su// mig gis g.yas g.yon gyen blta sngar ji bzhin// g.yon la'ang gong ltar byas rjes rdor skyil bca'// lag gnyis sar btsugs res kyis 'bebs chung gsum// rdor skyil bkrol zhing ha sprugs 'phur 'don bya/ ༈ /nā ro drug skor lus gnad rlung bzung bcas// lag gnyis khu tshur kha sbubs pus steng bzhag /pho ba g.yas gsum g.yon gsum bskor nas su// khu tshur sngon ltar dpung brgyang ro stod g.yas// g.yon bcas res mos gcud pa lan drug byed// khu tshur gyen bstan brlar bzhag mgrin pa g.yas// g.yon bcas gsum gsum bskor zhing mgo dgye sgu// gsum dang rdor skyil bshigs la gzhog g.yon phab// lag g.yon khu tshur nu thad bzhag lag g.yas// gyen brkyang bskum dang mchan brdeb mnyam bsgrigs kyis// rkang g.yas gyen brkyang bskum nas 'phang brdeb bya// de ltar lan gsum de nas gzhogs g.yas phab// gong ltar byas rjes rdor skyil khu tshur gnyis// mdun rgyab res mos yar byug gsum mar byug

/gsum mthar 'bebs chung gsum dang rdor skyil bshigs// ha sprugs sil dang 'phur 'don sogs bya'o/ ༈ /so bdun ma la lus gnad bca' rlung bzung*// lag gnyis khu tshur kha sbubs pus steng bzhag /pho bskor g.yas g.yon gsum re pus g.yas steng*// g.yas kyi khu tshur steng du g.yon pa brtsegs// pho bskor g.yas g.yon gsum re pus g.yon steng*// g.yon gyi khu tshur steng du g.yas pa brtsegs// pho bskor g.yas g.yon gsum re dang khu tshur// brlar bzhag gyen bstan lag g.yas mgor g.yon bskor// mchan brdeb mdun brkyang de 'dra gsum bya zhing*// g.yon gyi khu tshur mgo la g.yas bskor gyis// zhags 'phen sngar ltar rjes la mdun brkyang 'phral// g.yas kyi thal mos g.yon mthil dpung brang bar// byugs nas g.yon dpung brgyang pa mda' 'gengs tshul// g.yas mchan brdeb nas slar yang g.yas mthil gyis// brang nas dpung g.yon lag mthil byugs 'phral g.yas// dpung brgyang g.yon mchan brdeb sogs gong bzhin du// drug gi rjes la dpung g.yon mdun brkyangs la// dpung nang g.yas kyi khu tshur yar mar shad// gsum dang g.yas la'ang de bzhin 'bebs chung gsum// rdor skyil bkrol zhing ha sprugs 'phur 'don byed// skabs 'dir rlung bzung 'bebs chung gang nus bya/// / ༈ de nas nā ro'i yan lag lnga sbyong ni// lus gnad dang bcas rlung bzung khu tshur gnyis// kha sbubs pus steng bzhag la pho bskor g.yas// gsum dang g.yon gsum khu tshur gyen bstan brlar// bzhag cing mgrin pa g.yas gsum g.yon gsum bskor// mgrin pa g.yas kyog ga yon kyog gsum gsum dang*// mgo bo dgye sgu gsum bcas khu tshur gnyis// gyen gzhal thad brkyang g.yas kyi khu tshur gyis// phrag gong brdeg la g.yon pa'ang de ltar brdeg /slar yang g.yas kyis brdeg bcas lag gnyis ka /mchan brdeb mdun brkyang gsum bya thad brkyangs nas// g.yon g.yas phrag brdeg mchan brdeb sogs sngar ltar// rdor skyil bkrol 'phral tsog pur lag g.yon par// btsugs nas rkang g.yas mthe bong lag g.yas kyis// bzung nas mdun brkyang bskum pa gsum byas la// lag g.yas sar btsugs g.yon gyi'ang de ltar bya// tsog pur rkang bsnol lag gnyis 'khyud rgya'i tshul// gyen 'phag lag gnyis thad brkyang sems skyil bya// bar 'bebs gsum mthar ha sprugs 'phur 'don no/

༈ /de nas mai tri'i yan lag lnga sbyong ni// lus gnad rlung bzung khu tshur gnyis kha sbubs// brlar bzhag mgrin pa g.yas gsum g.yon gsum skor// mgrin pa g.yas kyog g.yon kyog gsum gsum dang*// mgo bo dgye sgu gsum gsum rdor skyil bkrol// pus mo btsugs la gru g.yon brgyang khu tshur// nu steng mnan la lag g.yas zhags 'phen dang*// mchan brdeb sogs bcas lan gsum slar yang ni// g.yas g.yon go ldog de ltar lan gsum bya// tsog pur lag gnyis sar btsugs rkang pa g.yas// thad la brkyang bskum gsum byed g.yon la'ang 'gre// bar 'bebs gsum dang ha sprugs 'phur 'don no// skabs 'dir rlung bzung bar 'bebs ci nus bya/ ༈ /rlung skyon sel dang yan lag lnga sbyong dang*// drug skor so bdun ma bcas rtsa ba bzhi// nā ro mai tri'i yan lag lnga sbyong bcas// bsnan pas rtsa ba drug ces yongs su grags// ༈ nyi ma drug skor tsog pur 'dug rlung bzung*// rkang pa gnyis bsnol lag gnyis bsnol phyir brkyang*// rkang mthil 'og nas yar la mthe bong bzung*// pho bskor g.yas drug g.yon drug rkang rting sar// btsugs nas 'phang btegs res mos de 'dra drug /de bzhin gyen 'phag drug bcas sna rlung btang*/ ༈ /gtum mo zhag bdun tsog pur 'dug rlung bzung*// rkang lag bsnol sogs gong bzhin rkang steng nas// mthe bong bzung la pho bskor g.yas gsum g.yon// gsum dang rting pa sar btsugs 'phang btegs res// gsum byed yar langs thog 'bebs lag gnyis kyis// pus steng gyen gzhal thad brkyang phrag gong phyir// gzhal nas khu tshur gyen bstan brlar bzhag 'phral// sems skyil dang bcas slar yang tsog pur 'dug /rkang mtheb bzung zhing pho bskor 'bebs la sogs// sngar bzhin gsum mthar ha sprugs 'phur 'don no/ ༈ /de nas gtum mo bco brgyad dang po la// rlung skyon sel bar lus gnad rkang g.yon mthil// lag g.yas phyir sbubs g.yon pa mdun brkyangs nas// mdzub bskor gru brgyang sna g.yon bkag g.yas nas// rngub cing 'bud pa gsum mam re re bya// mchan brdeb mdun brkyang lag g.yon g.yas rkang mthil// steng sbubs sna g.yas bkag sogs sngon ltar bya// khu tshur brlar sbubs sna gnyis rlung sngon bzhin/

༈ /gsum dang bum pa can rlung ci nus bzung*/ ༈ /me thab drug 'ching tsog pur rkang bsnol nas// pus steng gru btsugs lag bsnol thal mo gnyis// dpung par sbyar la bum can ci nus bzung*/ ༈ /ljon shing bsnol bar lag pa'i mkhrig ma bsnol// bzung zhing pus mo'i thad 'khyud rlung gong ltar/ ༈ /sku gsum bsnol ba rkang bol g.yon steng g.yas// mthil gyis mnan nas lag gnyis dpung bsnol bzung*// pus mo'i thad 'khyud rlung bzung gong ltar ro/ ༈ /btsan thabs drod 'bebs tsog pur rkang mtheb gnyis// lag gnyis bsnol 'dzin rlung bzung pho bskor g.yas// gsum dang g.yon gsum rkang mthil 'phang btegs res// gsum dang thad brkyang gsum mthar 'bebs chen ni// lang zhor 'khyud rgya phyir 'bab lag thad brkyang*// sems skyil de bzhin ci nus mthar rdor 'bebs// ha sprugs 'phur 'don skabs 'dir ngal gso'o/ ༈ /mkha' lding sbrul 'dzin lus gnad rlung bzung 'phral// rkang gnyis mdun brkyang pus steng lag khu tshur// sbubs la gyen lang rkang lag rtse sar btsugs// mgo bkug mig gyen blta zhing gzhogs g.yas g.yon// dgang 'dren gsum gsum 'bebs chen sogs sngar ltar/ ༈ /byings sel bya rgod 'phur la lus gnad sogs// sngar ltar byas la gyen langs rkang g.yas bskum// g.yon brkyang lag gnyis thad brkyang phrag gong brdeg /res mos nā ro'i yan lag nang ltar gyi// mchan brdeb mdun brkyang sogs dang rkang g.yon bskum// g.yas brkyang lag gnyis phrag rdeg sogs gong bzhin// de mthar 'bebs chen la sogs sngar ltar ro/ ༈ /rgod sel shes pa bum par bzung lus gnad// rlung bcas lta stangs smad la lag gnyis phyir// bsnol mar kha sbubs rkang gnyis mthil du sbyar/ ༈ /sna nas rlung btang spyang mo nyal ba ni// lus gnad rlung bzung de dang gzhog g.yas sar// gtad nas rkang pa gnyis bskum pus brang sprad// lag g.yas g.yon gyi mchan steng bkab g.yon pas// pus mo gnyis 'khyud nyal mthar lus gnad bca'/

༈ /sna nas rlung btang mkha' la dbab pa ni// lus gnad rlung bcas de nas gan rkyal 'dug /lag gnyis khu tshur rkang pa gnyis bskums nas// gyen 'phag rkang lag gyen brkyang phyir bskum gsum// thal mo bsgrad bsdom gyen 'phag sogs sngar ltar// gsum mthar lang nas 'bebs chen ha sprugs 'phur/ ༈ /ne le res 'jog lus gnad rlung bzung nas// yar lang lag g.yon khu tshur dkur brten nas// rkang g.yon sar btsugs g.yas kyi rkang lag gnyis// mdun ngos phyir la brkyang bskum lag mchan brdeb// rkang rting 'phang brdeb mnyam sbrags g.yon la'ang*// de ltar bya zhing 'bebs chen ha sprugs 'phur/ ༈ /thig le 'dren bzhir rlung ni rang bab ngang*// dang po ri rab 'phur ba lus gnad bca'// khu tshur brlar bzhag ro stod lhod nas su// g.yon g.yas dbus gsum gyen drang khong sgra bcas// hūm̐ ring bcu dang hūm̐ thung bcus yar 'dren// mig 'bras gyen ldog lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ 'dren bzhi rigs 'gre dgos*/ lto ba sgal sbyar rjes la ha sprugs bya'o/ ༈ /wa yi bzhad tshul lus gnad khu tshur gnyis// nu steng bzhag la gru brgyang ro stod lhod// hūm̐ gi khong sgras gyen drangs sogs sngon bzhin/ ༈ /yi dwags 'dug stangs rkang rtse gnyis sar btsugs// rting sprad dpung brgyang khu tshur pus steng mnan// phyed lang tsam byas mig gyen ldog blta sogs// gsum dang hig ka ring thung gnyis kyis gyen// drangs shing 'phang dang rkang rting rdeb chung gsum// slar yang phyed lang la sogs sngon ltar du// lan gnyis rjes la 'bebs chen ha sprugs bya'o/ ༈ /seṅge gyen logs skyil krung bar lag gnyis// khu tshur mtheb mdzub gung gsum sar btsugs nas// haṃ ka ra brjod g.yas g.yon dbus gyen drang*// rdor skyil yar bkyag mdun brdeg bcas de ltar/ ༈ /gsum mthar ha sprugs 'phur 'don seng ge rtsal// sprugs ni lus gnad rlung bzung rdor skyil bshigs// khu tshur pus steng yar khyer bar 'bebs dang*// mchan brdeb dus gcig byas la g.yas g.yon dbus// thal mo phyed btsum de bzhin lan gsum mthar// pha ha ha brjod rlung btang bar 'bebs gsum/

༈ /seṅge rnam rol lus gnad rlung bzung 'phral// khu tshur pus steng yar khyer mchan brdeb 'phral// zad brkyang tshur bskum srin lag mthe'u chung gis// kha bkab gung mos sna dang mdzub mos mig /bkab cing mthe bong rna ba bkab nas su// ro stod g.yas bskor gsum dang g.yon bskor gsum// ma ha ha brjod rlung btang bar 'bebs gsum/ ༈ /snyan brgyud drug las seṅge brtse ba ni// rlung ni rang babs sems skyil lag gnyis bsnol// g.yon pas rkang g.yas long bu bsdom g.yas pas// bol mthil nas bzung rkang g.yon bskum 'og sgor// bzhag la ha 'dren gyen 'then lhod lan gsum// rkang lag g.yas g.yon brjes la gong ltar bcas/ ༈ /ha sprugs 'phur 'don stag mo skyug pa ni// rlung ni rang bab rdor skyil 'og lag gnyis// phyir bstan sbubs la ha sprugs tshul rdor skyil// mdun brdeb dang bcas gsum mthar rdor skyil bshig ༈ /ha sprugs 'phur 'don glang chen 'gying lus gnad// rlung bzung rdor skyil bshigs la rkang pa gnyis// mdun brkyang lag gnyis phyir sbubs brkyangs nas su// rkang pa'i long bu'i phyi nas yar gzhal la// yar lang mchan brdeb rkang lag sar btsugs sgur// rkang gnyis bar la mkhyid gang bzhag lag g.yon// khu tshur steng du g.yas bzhag mgo rgur zhing*// gyen 'then gsum dang 'phang tshos rkang rting brdeg /gsum bcas yar long sngar ltar rgur sogs bcas// gsum mthar 'bebs chen ha sprugs 'phur 'don no/ ༈ /rus sbal bskum ni lus gnad sogs sngar bzhin// yar langs mchan brdeb rkang gnyis bar khru gang*// bzhag la lag gnyis brla nang phyir 'khyud nas// rkang mtheb bzung la dgang 'dren g.yas g.yon dbus// 'then zhing lus stod 'phar 'dar gsum 'bebs chen/ ༈ /sngar ltar bya zhing rma bya 'phur la yang*// lus gnad la sogs gong bzhin yar langs nas// mdun ngos rting sig phyir sgur lag gnyis kyis// rkang gnyis mthe bong dam bzung mgo bkug nas/

'phang sar btsugs nas rkang gnyis drang por gyen// brkyang la bzung nas de ngang yar lang nas// phyir sgur la sogs lan gsum rjes 'bebs chen/ ༈ /sngar ltar byas la bya rgod 'phur gong bzhin// lus gnad rigs 'gre'i gtum mo bco brgyad nang*// bya rgod 'phur dang mtshungs shing lan gsum mthar// 'bebs chen ha sprugs 'phur 'don ngal gso zhing*// mnyam bzhag ngo bo skyong sogs kun la 'gre'o/ ༈ /de nas rkyang 'bebs lus gnad rlung bzung nas// rdor skyil bshigs la yar lang rkang pa gshib// lag gnyis thur brkyang lus po 'phangs pa'i tshul// sar brdab rkang brkyang lus stod drang po'i ngang*// yar la phyir 'phangs de ltar gsum gyi mthar// 'bebs chen ha sprugs 'phur 'don slar yang ni/ ༈ /'bebs chen lus gnad rlung bzung yar lang nas// rkang gnyis gshib pa'i 'bebs chen ci nus dang*/ ༈ /rkang gnyis bsgrad pa'i 'bebs chen ci nus dang*/ ༈ /rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i 'bebs chen ci nus bcas/ ༈ /ha sprugs 'phur 'don rlung gegs sel ba ni// lus gnad rlung bzung khu tshur brlar sbub cing*// mig gis g.yas dang g.yon blta g.yas bltas la// ha ha ha brjod de bzhin g.yon g.yas sogs// bzhir byas rdor skyil bshigs la lag gnyis kyis// rdo rje rtse gcig phyag rgya gyen brkyang bskum// bar 'bebs dang sbrags ha 'don de ltar du// drug gam bdun mthar ha sprugs 'phur 'don no/ ༈ /yang na gegs sel sems skyil pus mo'i steng*// khu tshur spubs la gzhogs g.yas g.yon bcas dkyu// pus brang 'phrod tsam de bzhin gsum tsam bya'o/ ༈ /rjes rim yan lag lnga sbyong bsdus pa dang*/ ༈ /mtha' rten sems skyil rkang g.yas long bu'i steng*// khu tshur gnyis brtsegs hūm̐ sgras lan gsum du// gyen 'dren de mthar ha sprugs sil sil dang*// yan lag nying lag 'phur 'don drag tu bya// gzhan yang gegs sel nā ro'i gzer lnga dang*// mar pa'i lnga bcu pa sogs las gsal zhing*// kun gyi snying po gnas lugs gnyug ma'i don// rang sems ngo bo skyong ba mchog tu gsungs// de ltar rdor 'chang dgongs pa'i gnad zab bcud// 'phags yul grub brnyes rim brgyud lo tsā cher// gdams pa'i man ngag yang gces 'khrul 'khor gyi// lus sbyong 'bad pas rtsa mdud rang sar grol// rlung la dbang thob thig le brten nas su// bde stong ye shes zag med ting 'dzin rgyas// tshe gcig chos sku'i go 'phang bde blag tu// thob byed tshegs chung don che'i gnas su nges// lam 'dir zhugs pa'i skal ldan rnams// lam bzang ma nor 'dir 'bad nas// lam gyi mthar thug phyag rgya che 'i// lam mchog mngon du rtogs gyur cig
ces pa'ang gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun bzhin/ si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos zin thor spel ba dge/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
